title: BioIVT CMROUTE fields use the shared canonical CDASH CMROUTE list
description: Points every field named CMROUTE across BioIVT studies at the shared canon_cm_route canonical choice list (CDASH C78420, plus two documented sponsor extensions: intravenous, other). Replaces both studies' abbreviated, mismatched route codes (Precision used SC, Detroit used SC_R for the same route) with the governed, full-word CDASH submission values.
rationale: BioIVT Data Mastering project, Option C recommendation. Dan's standing rule for BioIVT: when two studies disagree and CDASH has a standard, apply the CDASH standard regardless of what either study currently does. CMROUTE has an official CDASH codelist (C78420) but neither study's current abbreviated codes (ORAL, IV, IM, SC/SC_R, TOP, INH) match the real CDISC submission values, which are full words. Applying the standard here changes values in both studies, not just the one that disagreed (Detroit's SC_R) -- confirmed with Dan in chat (2026-09-28, 'go with 2') before writing this file.
source: NCI EVS CDISC CDASH Controlled Terminology CMROUTE C78420; canonical-code-list-library plan step 1c

history.note: Second BioIVT customer-scoped convention. Converts both studies' route codes to the full CDASH submission-value vocabulary, not just the values that disagreed between studies.
